name: Ontario Police Youth Academy
what_you_do: Learn how police work in free classes. You learn about crime labs, SWAT, police dogs, patrol, car safety, gangs, bullying, online safety and respect.
duration: A series of evening classes at the Ontario Police Department. The page does not say how many weeks.
deadline_text: Registration is closed. The page still shows the last academy start, Tuesday, May 27, at 6 pm (May 27 was a Tuesday in 2025), and no next date.
how_to_apply: Check the Youth Academy page for the next sign-up. Or call the police station to ask.
notes: The page lists no phone number or email for the academy, so ask at the police department front desk. Confirm the next dates before you plan on it.
